steps: Enroll in a budgeting course on Coursera or LinkedIn Learning to master financial planning.
Practice FP&A by building a simple financial model using Excel for a mock company.
Take an online accounting fundamentals course to strengthen your accounting skills.
Volunteer to assist with annual report preparation or audit support in your current role.
Network with finance professionals to learn about board materials and real-world applications.
